features.feature_value: Used fairness/same criteria for both versions (tone/target/language) rather than political stance; removal consistency across sides.

features.feature_value: Decided based on whether posts stayed in political argument or crossed into personal attacks/slurs/harassment.

features.feature_value: Applied the same standard to both versions, focusing on substance and tone rather than which political side it represented.
features.evidence_span: "I focus on substance and tone, not political side"
features.rationale: They describe using the pair to compare by criteria independent of partisan labeling.

features.feature_value: Kept/enabled both sides to create an even playing field for both sides.
